argv:
set -euo pipefail
# F15: Exact production-scope loop - reject test-only, require every layer
changed="$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD)"
cmd_prod=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^cmd/leamas/[^/]+\.go$' | grep -v '_test\.go$' | head -1)
closure_prod=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^internal/factory/closure/[^/]+\.go$' | grep -v '_test\.go$' | head -1)
authority_prod=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^internal/factory/authority/[^/]+\.go$' | grep -v '_test\.go$' | head -1)
capabilities=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^\.factory/required-capabilities\.json$')
if [ -z "$cmd_prod" ]; then echo "FAIL: no cmd/leamas production file" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -z "$closure_prod" ]; then echo "FAIL: no internal/factory/closure production file" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -z "$authority_prod" ]; then echo "FAIL: no internal/factory/authority production file" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -z "$capabilities" ]; then echo "FAIL: no .factory/required-capabilities.json" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "PASS: Exact production scope verified"
echo "  cmd: $cmd_prod"
echo "  closure: $closure_prod"
echo "  authority: $authority_prod"
echo "  capabilities: $capabilities"

set -euo pipefail
# F15: Direct black-box external lifecycle against REAL v2 CLI
# Real v2 flags: --protocol v2 --json --repo --plan --subject (NO --plan-freeze, --evidence-dir, --manifest-out)
# Real JSON output schema: TransactionResult with runner, subject, F, S, C, C_tree, verdict

# 1. Capture Leamas source root BEFORE entering temp dirs
LEAMAS_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
LEAMAS_HEAD="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cd "$LEAMAS_ROOT"

# 2. Build Leamas from captured source root with -buildvcs=true for VCS authority
BUILD_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"' RETURN
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -buildvcs=true -trimpath -o "$BUILD_DIR/leamas" ./cmd/leamas
LEAMAS_BIN="$BUILD_DIR/leamas"
MEASURED_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$LEAMAS_BIN" | cut -d' ' -f1)

# 3. Create external target repository with .gitignore for evidence
TARGET_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR" "$TARGET_DIR"' RETURN
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" init -b main --quiet
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" config user.email 'target@example.com'
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" config user.name 'Target'
cat > "$TARGET_DIR/.gitignore" <<GIEOF
.factory/
GIEOF
echo 'subject baseline' > "$TARGET_DIR/README.md"
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" add .gitignore README.md
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" commit -m 'baseline' --quiet
B_HEAD=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)
B_TREE=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse HEAD^{tree})

# 4. Generate target-specific plan with TARGET B as baseline
# Plan check: assert target root via runtime test, NOT go version
PLAN_DIR="$TARGET_DIR/docs/closure-plans"
mkdir -p "$PLAN_DIR"
PLAN_FILE="$PLAN_DIR/ACT-LEAMAS-PORTABLE-RUNNER-TARGET01.json"
cat > "$PLAN_FILE" <<PLANEOF
{
  "contract_version": 1,
  "act_id": "ACT-LEAMAS-PORTABLE-RUNNER-TARGET01",
  "baseline": {
    "commit_oid": "$B_HEAD",
    "tree_oid": "$B_TREE"
  },
  "execution": {
    "mode": "serial_fail_fast"
  },
  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "target-root",
      "mode": "run",
      "argv": [
        "bash",
        "-c",
        "test \"\$(git -C . rev-parse --show-toplevel)\" = \"$(printf '%s' "$TARGET_DIR" | sed 's/[&/\\\\]/\\\\&/g')\""
      ],
      "working_directory": ".",
      "timeout_seconds": 60,
      "environment": {}
    }
  ],
  "artifacts": [],
  "policy": {
    "require_clean_before": true,
    "require_clean_after": true,
    "forbid_tracked_full_digests": true,
    "require_diff_check": true
  }
}
PLANEOF
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" add docs/closure-plans
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" commit -m 'freeze plan' --quiet
F_HEAD=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)

# 5. Empty commit for subject
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" commit --allow-empty -m 'subject commit' --quiet
SUBJECT=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)
SUBJECT_TREE=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse HEAD^{tree})

# 6. Invoke real CLI with ONLY supported v2 flags (no --plan-freeze, --evidence-dir, --manifest-out)
export LEAMAS_NO_TELEMETRY=1
STDERR_FILE="$BUILD_DIR/stderr.txt"
STDOUT_FILE="$BUILD_DIR/stdout.txt"
set +e
"$LEAMAS_BIN" factory close run \
  --protocol v2 \
  --json \
  --repo "$TARGET_DIR" \
  --plan "$PLAN_FILE" \
  --subject "$SUBJECT" \
  >"$STDOUT_FILE" 2>"$STDERR_FILE"
EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e
if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: v2 CLI exit $EXIT_CODE" >&2
  echo "--- stdout ---" >&2
  cat "$STDOUT_FILE" >&2
  echo "--- stderr ---" >&2
  cat "$STDERR_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# 7. Parse JSON TransactionResult from CLI stdout and inspect canonical fields
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null; then echo "FAIL: jq not available" >&2; exit 1; fi
RUNNER_VCS=$(jq -r '.runner.vcs_revision // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
RUNNER_SHA=$(jq -r '.runner.binary_sha256 // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
RUNNER_VERDICT=$(jq -r '.verdict // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
SUBJ_OID=$(jq -r '.S // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
SUBJ_TREE=$(jq -r '.C_tree // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
FREEZE=$(jq -r '.F // empty' "$STDOUT_FILE")
if [ -z "$RUNNER_VCS" ] || [ -z "$RUNNER_SHA" ] || [ -z "$SUBJ_OID" ] || [ -z "$SUBJ_TREE" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: JSON missing required fields" >&2
  cat "$STDOUT_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$RUNNER_VERDICT" != "pass" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: verdict=$RUNNER_VERDICT (expected pass)" >&2
  cat "$STDOUT_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$SUBJ_OID" != "$SUBJECT" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: result.S ($SUBJ_OID) != subject ($SUBJECT)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$SUBJ_TREE" != "$SUBJECT_TREE" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: result.C_tree ($SUBJ_TREE) != subject tree ($SUBJECT_TREE)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$FREEZE" != "$F_HEAD" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: result.F ($FREEZE) != freeze ($F_HEAD)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$RUNNER_VCS" = "$SUBJECT" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: runner.vcs_revision equals subject commit" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$RUNNER_SHA" != "$MEASURED_SHA256" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: runner.binary_sha256 ($RUNNER_SHA) != measured ($MEASURED_SHA256)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# 8. Verify target is clean after close
git -C "$TARGET_DIR" status --porcelain=v1
TARGET_DIRTY_AFTER=$(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" status --porcelain=v1)
if [ -n "$TARGET_DIRTY_AFTER" ]; then echo "FAIL: target dirty after close" >&2; echo "$TARGET_DIRTY_AFTER" >&2; exit 1; fi

echo "PASS: Direct black-box external lifecycle verified"
echo "  Target HEAD: $SUBJECT"
echo "  Target TREE: $SUBJECT_TREE"
echo "  Freeze: $F_HEAD"
echo "  Leamas Rev: $LEAMAS_HEAD"
echo "  Runner VCS: $RUNNER_VCS"
echo "  Runner SHA: $RUNNER_SHA"

set -euo pipefail
require_subtest_pass() {
  package="$1"
  test_name="$2"
  subtest_name="$3"
  full_name="${test_name}/${subtest_name}"
  output="$(mktemp)"
  trap 'rm -f "$output"' RETURN
  if ! go test -json -count=1 -run "^${full_name}$" "$package" >"$output" 2>&1; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  run_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"run".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  pass_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"pass".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  skip_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"skip".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  fail_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"fail".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  if [ "$run_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$pass_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$skip_count" -ne 0 ] || [ "$fail_count" -ne 0 ]; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    printf 'FAIL: %s run=%s pass=%s skip=%s fail=%s\n' "$full_name" "$run_count" "$pass_count" "$skip_count" "$fail_count" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$full_name"
}
echo 'Verifying behavioral regression tests...'
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository RecognizedByCLI
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository PropagatedIntoRunRequest
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository GitAuthorityUsesTargetRepo
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository ChecksUseTargetRepoAsWorkingDirectory
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository ManifestRecordsTargetRepo
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestFactoryCloseRunRepoFlagRoutesTargetRepository DefaultDoesNotSilentlyReplaceExplicitRepo
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI DistinctRepositories
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI ToolRevisionDiffersFromTargetSubject
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI RealCLIInvocation
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI TargetHEADAndTreeBound
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI ChecksExecuteInTargetRepository
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerExternalRepositoryCLI ManifestSeparatesToolAndTarget
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix WrongPlanPinnedBinaryHash
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix SubstitutedExecutable
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix WrongToolRevision
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix ModifiedToolBuild
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix WrongTargetHEAD
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix WrongTargetTree
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix DirtyTargetBefore
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix DirtyTargetAfter
require_subtest_pass ./cmd/leamas TestPortableRunnerNegativeAuthorityMatrix SubjectExactCrossRepository
echo 'Behavioral regression tests verified'
